review_scope: 12 sampled pre-action images per existing video, 48 images total; all 880 frames decoded but not all manually classified

entries.visual_observation: The target-looking bowl moves with the gripper toward and past the plate edge. The sampled late frames show it outside the plate while the gripper remains mostly closed.
The bowl moves with the gripper toward the plate but is not visibly deposited on it in sampled late frames. A sustained successful release is not visible.
The gripper remains near the bowl/cookie area. The sampled sequence does not show stable lifted transport to the plate; late commands repeatedly open and close.
The gripper stays near the original bowl/cookie area with no clear stable lifted transport in sampled frames, followed by repeated opening/closing.

limits: Stage labels are visual interpretations, not unique causal diagnoses.
Finger joint closure does not prove successful grasp or contact.
Policy videos omit the final post-action frame; trace/log success=False supplies the final task outcome.
Do not infer quantization failure, training sufficiency, or a model success rate from these annotations.
